chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting
chunks.question: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 3 Attach the Brackets to the Gate Opener Arm
chunks.question: Attach the Brackets to the Gate Opener Arm
chunks.embedding_text: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 3: Attach the Brackets to the Gate Opener Arm. Connect post bracket and gate bracket to opener arm with clevis pin and hairpin clip.
chunks.content_zh: 将后支架组件和门支架通过插入开口销连接到开门机臂。 使用发夹式开口销固定开口销。
chunks.content_en: Attach the post bracket assembly and the gate bracket to the gate opener arm by inserting a clevis pin. Secure the clevis pin using the hairpin clip.

images.caption: Attaching brackets to the gate opener arm

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 4 Release the Clutch
chunks.question: Release the Clutch
chunks.embedding_text: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 4: Release the Clutch. Open release plug, insert manual release key, turn 90° clockwise to manual mode for rod extension/retraction.
chunks.content_zh: 打开开门机顶部的释放孔塞。 插入手动释放钥匙，并顺时针转动90°。 开门机现在处于手动模式，允许手动伸缩移动杆。
chunks.content_en: Open the release hole plug on the top of the gate opener. Insert the manual release key, and turn it 90° clockwise. The gate opener is now in manual mode, allowing for manual extension and retraction of the moving rod.

images.caption: Releasing the clutch with manual key

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 5 Position the Gate Opener on the Gate
chunks.question: Position the Gate Opener on the Gate
chunks.embedding_text: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 5: Position the Gate Opener on the Gate. Clamp opener arm with post bracket to marked position on gate post. Ensure arm retracted, gate fully open. Use level and C-clamp to secure gate bracket when arm is level.
chunks.content_zh: 将开门机臂与后支架组件一起夹在门柱上的标记位置。 确保开门机臂完全收回，并且门完全打开到所需位置。 将水平仪放在臂上，然后使用C型夹将门支架固定到门上，当臂水平时。
chunks.content_en: Clamp the gate opener arm along with the post bracket assembly to the marked position on the gate post. Make sure that the gate opener arm is fully retracted and the gate is fully opened to the desired position. Put a level on the arm, then use a C-clamp to secure the gate bracket onto the gate when the arm is level.

images.caption: Positioning the gate opener on the gate

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting
chunks.question: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 6 Test Gate Travel and Mark the Brackets Mounting Locations
chunks.question: Test Gate Travel and Mark the Brackets Mounting Locations
chunks.embedding_text: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 6 Test Gate Travel and Mark the Brackets Mounting Locations. Manually open and close gate, ensure 2.5cm (1") minimum clearance between gate and opener. Prevent binding. Mark mounting locations. NOTE: This step is important for gate opener arm position and opening angle; watch YouTube video for guidance.
chunks.content_zh:
手动打开和关闭门，确保门支架位置正确。
确保门与开门机之间至少有 2.5 厘米 (1 英寸) 的间隙。
确保开门机不会与外拉式支架卡住。
如果间隙小于 2.5 厘米 (1 英寸)，或者开门机与外拉式支架卡住，请旋转外拉式支架和/或移动立柱支架组件。
标记支架安装位置的中心点。

注意：此步骤对于确定开门机臂的位置和开门角度非常重要。强烈建议观看我们的 YouTube 分步安装视频以获取指导。
chunks.content_en:
Manually open and close the gate to ensure that the gate bracket position is correct.
Ensure that there is a minimum clearance of 2.5cm (1") between the gate and the opener.
Make sure that the gate opener does not bind against the pull-to-open bracket.
If the clearance is less than 2.5cm (1"), or if the gate opener and the pull-to-open bracket are binding, rotate the pull-to-open bracket and/or move the post bracket assembly.
Mark the center of the mounting locations for the brackets.

NOTE: This step is very important for determining the position of the gate opener arm and the gate opening angle. It is highly recommended to watch our step-by-step installation video on YouTube for guidance.

images.caption: Minimum clearance and gate travel for pull-to-open setup.

chunks.section: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 7 Drill Bracket Mounting Holes
chunks.question: Drill Bracket Mounting Holes
chunks.embedding_text: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 7 Drill Bracket Mounting Holes. Remove C-clamps and gate opener arm. Drill 10.5mm (0.4") diameter holes through the post and the gate at marked locations.
chunks.content_zh:
拆下 C 型夹和开门机臂。
在标记位置，用 10.5 毫米 (0.4 英寸) 直径的钻头在立柱和门上钻孔。
chunks.content_en:
Remove the C-clamps and the gate opener arm.
Drill 10.5mm (0.4") diameter holes through the post and the gate at the marked locations.

images.caption: Drilling 10.5mm holes for bracket mounting.

chunks.section: Push-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting
chunks.question: Push-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting

chunks.section: Push-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 1 Assemble the Post Bracket and the Push-to-Open Bracket
chunks.question: Assemble the Post Bracket and the Push-to-Open Bracket
chunks.embedding_text: Push-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 1 Assemble Post Bracket Push-to-Open Bracket bolts washers nuts assembly diagram
chunks.content_en:
Insert the bolts through the holes of post bracket and push-to-open bracket, and fasten with washer and nut as shown.
DO NOT over tighten the nut because the post bracket may need to be adjusted later.

images.caption: Post Bracket Assembly

chunks.section: Push-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting · 2 Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly
chunks.question: Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly
chunks.embedding_text: Push-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 2 Determine Position Post Bracket Assembly gate opening angle dimensions A B installation guide table values
chunks.content_en:
The table shows the maximum opening angle of the gate based on the dimensions of A and B. For example, if A is 15cm (5.9") and B is 12cm (4.7"), the maximum opening angle of the gate is 110°.
Measure the dimension of A and B to determine the desired gate opening angle, and then mark the center of the mounting locations for the post bracket accordingly.
Push-to-Open Installation — Gate in closed position with the moving rod fully retracted.

images.caption: Gate Opener Mounting Position Diagram with Dimensions A and B
Maximum Gate Opening Angle based on Dimensions A and B

chunks.section: Mount Control Box
chunks.question: Mount Control Box

chunks.section: Mount Control Box · 1 Identify a suitable mounting location
chunks.question: Identify a suitable mounting location
chunks.embedding_text: Mount Control Box STEP 1 Identify a suitable mounting location Control box installation distance requirements: Min 1m (3.3ft) from ground, Max 10m (33ft) from gate opener arm.
chunks.content_zh: 确定控制箱的合适安装位置，距离地面至少1米（3.3英尺），距离开门器臂不超过10米（33英尺），以防止被洪水淹没或被雪覆盖。
chunks.content_en: Identify a suitable mounting location for the control box at least 1m (3.3ft.) above the ground and no more than 10m (33ft.) from the gate opener arm to prevent it from being flooded or buried under snow.

images.caption: Control box mounting location requirements: Min 1m (3.3ft) from ground, Max 10m (33ft) from gate opener arm.

chunks.section: Mount Control Box · 2 Secure the control box
chunks.question: Secure the control box
chunks.embedding_text: Mount Control Box STEP 2 Secure the control box Installation with screws and expansion tubes. Cable outlet must face downward.
chunks.content_zh: 使用木螺钉（不含）固定控制箱。如果安装在墙壁上，请使用膨胀管（不含）。注意：确保电缆出线孔朝下，以便正常排水。
chunks.content_en: Secure the control box using deck screws (NOT included). Use expansion tubes (NOT included) if mounting to a wall. CAUTION: Make sure that the cable outlet hole is facing downward for proper drainage.

images.caption: Securing the control box to a wall using screws and ensuring cable outlet is facing downward for drainage.

chunks.section: Terminal Function of the Control Board
chunks.question: Terminal Function of the Control Board
chunks.content_zh: 控制板端子功能整页（第18页）：21 个编号端子（①-㉑）按功能组说明接线用途。
chunks.content_en: Terminal Function of the Control Board (page 18): 21 numbered terminals grouped by function.

images.caption: 控制板端子功能表整页

chunks.section: Terminal Function of the Control Board
chunks.question: Terminal Function of the Control Board
chunks.embedding_text: Terminal Function of the Control Board 控制板接线端子功能 +24 PHOTO GND O/S/C COM OPSW EDGE LOCK BAT ADAPTER LAMP MOTOR DLMT ULMT
chunks.content_zh: 控制板端子功能对照表：①+24、③GND 端子输出24VDC电压为光电传感器供电；②PHOTO、③GND 接收光电传感器信号，常闭(NC)输入；④O/S/C、⑤COM 通过常开干接点信号控制大门循环开/停/关/停，常接推杆开关、有线密码器、外接收器；⑥OPSW、⑤COM 接收车辆检测器常开输出的开门信号；⑦EDGE、⑧GND 接收防夹边缘传感器常开信号；⑨⑩+LOCK- 输出接大门电锁正负极，要求失电闭锁型、额定24VDC、额定电流<3A；⑪⑫+BAT- 输入接24VDC电池或电源正负极，为整个系统供电；⑬⑭ADAPTER 输入接适配器为电池充电，也可接36VDC或24VAC电源；⑮⑯+LAMP- 输出接警示灯正负极，要求额定24VDC、额定电流<1A；⑰⑱+MOTOR- 接机械臂电机红黑线；⑲DLMT、⑳COM、㉑ULMT 接限位开关，近端限位接DLMT和COM，远端限位接ULMT和COM。
chunks.content_en: Terminal Function table: (1)+24 (3)GND - Provide 24VDC to power photocell sensors. (2)PHOTO (3)GND - Receive photocell NC signal. (4)O/S/C (5)COM - Open/stop/close/stop cycling via NO dry contact. (6)OPSW (5)COM - Vehicle sensor NO opening signal. (7)EDGE (8)GND - Edge sensor NO. (9)(10)+LOCK- - Electric lock fail-secure 24VDC <3A. (11)(12)+BAT- - 24VDC battery/power input. (13)(14)ADAPTER - Adapter charging; 36VDC or 24VAC. (15)(16)+LAMP- - Warning light 24VDC <1A. (17)(18)+MOTOR- - Motor red/black wires. (19)DLMT (20)COM (21)ULMT - Limit switches; near-end DLMT/COM, far-end ULMT/COM.

images.caption: 控制板正视图，标注21个编号端子位置（①-㉑），分为电源输出、传感器输入、锁控制、电池/适配器输入、警示灯输出、电机与限位开关六组端子区

chunks.question: NOTE
chunks.embedding_text: Connect the Arm to the Control Board, NOTE, installation video, wire connection
chunks.content_zh: 注意：强烈建议观看我们在 YouTube 上的分步安装视频以了解接线连接。
chunks.content_en: NOTE: It is highly recommended to watch our step-by-step installation video on YouTube for wire connection.

chunks.section: Connect the Arm to the Control Board · Connecting Motor Wires to Control Board
chunks.question: Connecting Motor Wires to Control Board
chunks.embedding_text: Connect the Arm to the Control Board, Connecting Motor Wires, terminal 17 +MOTOR1, terminal 18 MOTOR1-, terminal 19 DLMT, terminal 20 COM, terminal 21 ULMT, red wire, black wire, blue wire, green wire, yellow wire, wiring diagram
chunks.content_zh: 将线束穿过电缆密封套插入控制箱。将红线连接到端子 17 “+MOTOR1”，黑线连接到端子 18 “MOTOR1-”，蓝线连接到端子 19 “DLMT”，绿线连接到端子 20 “COM”，黄线连接到端子 21 “ULMT”。拧紧每个螺钉，以确保电线不会松动和脱落。
chunks.content_en: Insert the wire harness through the cable gland into the control box. Connect the red wire into terminal 17 “+MOTOR1”, the black wire into terminal 18 “MOTOR1-” , the blue wire into terminal 19 “DLMT”, the green wire into terminal 20 “COM”, and the yellow wire into terminal 21 “ULMT”. Tighten each of the screws so that the wires do not come loose and fall out.

images.caption: Wiring diagram illustrating the connection of motor wires (Red, Black, Blue, Green, Yellow) to control board terminals 17 (+MOTOR), 18 (-MOTOR), 19 (DLMT), 20 (COM), 21 (ULMT).

chunks.section: Important Safety Information
chunks.question: Important Safety Information
chunks.content_zh: 重要安全信息
chunks.content_en: Important Safety Information

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · During Installation: Installer and End User Responsibility
chunks.question: During Installation: Installer and End User Responsibility
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装期间 安装人员和最终用户责任 经验 安装 不当安装 财产损失 严重伤害 死亡 系统安全 WARNING SAFETY INSTALLATION RESPONSIBILITY
chunks.content_zh: 有经验的安装人员应进行安装。不当安装可能导致财产损失、严重伤害或死亡。开门机只是整个开门系统的一部分，安装人员和最终用户有责任确保整个系统对其预期用途是安全的。
chunks.content_en: An experienced installer should perform the installation. Improper installation may result in property damage, severe injury or death. The gate opener is only part of the entire gate operating system, and it is the responsibility of the installer and end user to ensure that the total system is safe for its intended use.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · During Installation: Disconnect the Power Supply
chunks.question: During Installation: Disconnect the Power Supply
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装期间 断开电源 供电 断电 电线连接 调整 WARNING SAFETY DISCONNECT POWER
chunks.content_zh: 在连接电线或进行任何调整之前，请确保开门机已断电。
chunks.content_en: Ensure that the gate opener is powered off before electrical wire connections or making any adjustments.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · During Installation: Avoid Entrapment Zones
chunks.question: During Installation: Avoid Entrapment Zones
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装期间 避免夹伤区域 儿童 宠物 牲畜 受伤 死亡 风险 WARNING SAFETY ENTRAPMENT ZONES
chunks.content_zh: 让儿童、宠物或牲畜远离夹伤区域，以避免受伤或死亡的风险。
chunks.content_en: Keep children, pets or livestock away from the entrapment zones to avoid the risk of injury or death.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · During Installation: Install Inside Property Boundaries
chunks.question: During Installation: Install Inside Property Boundaries
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装期间 安装在物业内部 物业边界 公众接触 WARNING SAFETY PROPERTY BOUNDARIES
chunks.content_zh: 将开门机安装在物业内部。请勿将其安装在公众可以接触到的门外。
chunks.content_en: Install the gate opener on the inside of the property. Do not install outside of the gate where the public has access to it.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · During Installation: Install Safety Sensor
chunks.question: During Installation: Install Safety Sensor
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装期间 安装安全传感器 光电传感器 障碍物 儿童 宠物 自动关闭 最大失速力 车辆出口传感器 WARNING SAFETY SENSOR PHOTOCELL
chunks.content_zh: 开门机设计为当门接触到障碍物时会停止并反转。强烈建议在以下情况下安装光电传感器以确保安全：如果您的物业有儿童或宠物，开门机自动关闭功能设置为开启，开门机失速力设置为最大，安装了车辆出口传感器，或使用了其他门控设备。
chunks.content_en: The gate opener is designed to stop and reverse the gate when the gate comes in contact with an obstruction. It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor in the following situations for safety: if you have children or pets at your property, the gate opener auto close function is set to ON, the gate opener stall force is set to the maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · During Installation: Gate Control Accessories Placement
chunks.question: During Installation: Gate Control Accessories Placement
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装期间 门控附件放置 控制器 1.5米 5英尺 移动部件 未经授权使用 WARNING SAFETY CONTROL ACCESSORIES PLACEMENT
chunks.content_zh: 用于用户激活的门控附件必须放置在距离门的任何移动部件至少1.5米（5英尺）的地方，并且用户无法越过、穿过、绕过或通过门来操作控制器。室外或易于接近的控制器应具有安全功能，以防止未经授权的使用。
chunks.content_en: Gate control accessories intended for user activation must be located at least 1.5 meters (5') away from any moving part of the gate and where the user is prevented from reaching over, under, around or through the gate to operate the controls. Outdoor or easily accessible controls shall have a security feature to prevent unauthorized use.

images.caption: Recommended placement for gate control accessories, at least 1.5m (5') away from moving parts.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · After Installation: Warning Signs
chunks.question: After Installation: Warning Signs
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装后 警示标志 自动开门系统 TOPENS 客户支持 更换 WARNING SAFETY SIGNS
chunks.content_zh: 将随附的警示标志粘贴在门的双侧，以提醒公众注意自动开门系统。如果您的标志损坏，请联系TOPENS客户支持更换。
chunks.content_en: Attach the provided warning signs to both sides of the gate to alert the public about the automatic gate opener system. If your signs are damaged, please reach out to TOPENS Customer Support for replacements.

images.caption: Attach warning signs to both sides of the gate.
Warning sign: Moving Gate Can Cause Serious Injury Or Death.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · After Installation: Away From Moving Gates
chunks.question: After Installation: Away From Moving Gates
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装后 远离移动的门 儿童 宠物 牲畜 危险 WARNING SAFETY MOVING GATES
chunks.content_zh: 让儿童、宠物和牲畜远离开门机系统，因为移动的门可能很危险。
chunks.content_en: Keep children, pets and livestock away from the gate opener system as moving gates can be dangerous.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · After Installation: Secure Gate Control Accessories
chunks.question: After Installation: Secure Gate Control Accessories
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装后 保护门控附件 儿童 遥控器 键盘 按钮 安全区域 WARNING SAFETY SECURE CONTROL ACCESSORIES
chunks.content_zh: 防止儿童操作门控制器，将遥控器、键盘和按钮放在他们无法触及的地方。不使用时，存放在安全区域。
chunks.content_en: Prevent children from operating gate controls by keeping remote transmitters, keypads, and push buttons out of their reach. Store in a secure area when not in use.

chunks.section: Important Safety Information · After Installation: Maintenance of Gate Opener System
chunks.question: After Installation: Maintenance of Gate Opener System
chunks.embedding_text: 重要安全信息 安装后 维护开门机系统 定期维护 自由摆动 水平 WARNING SAFETY MAINTENANCE
chunks.content_zh: 定期维护门和开门机系统，以确保门摆动自如并始终保持水平。
chunks.content_en: Regularly maintain the gate and gate opener system to ensure that the gate swings freely and remains level throughout

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply
chunks.question: Connection of Power Supply

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · IMPORTANT NOTES (Power Mode 1)
chunks.question: IMPORTANT NOTES (Power Mode 1)
chunks.embedding_text: IMPORTANT NOTES 重要注意事项 适配器 电池充电 输出电缆 1.2m 4ft 延长电缆 2C x 1.3 mm² 16AWG 100m 330ft 2C x 2 mm² 14AWG 300m 1000ft 开门机 电池供电 交流电充电 24VDC 7Ah 汽车 船用电池
chunks.content_zh:
适配器仅用于给电池充电。适配器输出电缆的长度为1.2m（4英尺）。如需延长电缆，电缆应至少为2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG)。如果控制板与适配器之间的距离超过100m（330英尺），电缆应至少为2C x 2 mm² (14AWG)。最大延长距离为300m（1000英尺）。
如果开门机由电池供电并使用交流电充电，则需要至少一块24VDC 7Ah汽车/船用型电池。
chunks.content_en:
The adapter is ONLY used to charge the battery. The length of the adapter output cable is 1.2m (4ft.). To extend the cable, the cable should be at least 2C x 1.3 mm² (16AWG). If the distance between the control board and the adapter is more than 100m (330ft.), the cable should be at least 2C x 2 mm² (14AWG). The maximum extension distance is 300m (1000ft.).
If the gate opener is powered by batteries and utilizes AC electricity for charging, a minimum of a 24VDC 7Ah automotive / marine type battery is required.

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · IMPORTANT NOTE (Power Mode 2)
chunks.question: IMPORTANT NOTE (Power Mode 2)
chunks.embedding_text: IMPORTANT NOTE 重要提示 DPS180-U 电源 不能连接 电池 太阳能板
chunks.content_zh: DPS180-U电源不能与电池或太阳能板连接。
chunks.content_en: The DPS180-U power supply can NOT connect with batteries or solar panels.

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · 1 Power Mode 1: By the Adapter and Batteries
chunks.question: Power Mode 1: By the Adapter and Batteries
chunks.embedding_text: Power Mode 1 电源模式1 适配器 电池 连接 TS24-U ADAPTER 端子 极性 12VDC 电池 串联 24VDC +BAT- 端子 电源插座
chunks.content_zh:
将TS24-U适配器连接到控制板的“ADAPTER”端子，不分接线极性。
串联连接两节12VDC电池以获得24VDC（不含电池）。
将电池连接到控制板的“+BAT-”端子。
将TS24-U适配器插入电源插座。
chunks.content_en:
Connect the TS24-U adapter to the “ADAPTER” terminals of the control board, regardless of the polarity of the wires.
Connect two 12VDC batteries in series to achieve 24VDC (batteries not included).
Connect the batteries to the “+BAT-” terminals of the control board.
Plug the TS24-U adapter into an electrical outlet.

images.caption: 电源模式1连接图 (适配器与电池)

chunks.section: Connection of Power Supply · 2 Power Mode 2: Use AC Electricity Only
chunks.question: Power Mode 2: Use AC Electricity Only
chunks.embedding_text: Power Mode 2 电源模式2 交流电 DPS180-U AC-DC 电源 公端子 母端子 +BAT- 端子 电源线 电源插座
chunks.content_zh:
将DPS180-U交流-直流电源（另售）输出线缆的公端子连接到与控制板“+BAT-”端子连接的电源输入线的母端子。
将DPS180-U电源线插入电源插座。
chunks.content_en:
Connect the male terminals from the output wires of the DPS180-U AC-DC power supply (sold separately) to the female terminals of the power input wires connected to the “+BAT-” terminals of the control board.
Plug the DPS180-U power cord into an electrical outlet.

chunks.content_zh:
接线时需要专业电工操作，以避免受伤、触电或死亡的风险。在所有安装完成之前，切勿将开门机连接到电源插座。

chunks.content_en:
A professional electrician is required for wire connection to avoid the risk of injury, electric shock, or death. NEVER connect the gate opener to the electrical outlet before all the installations have been done.
It is recommended to use a surge protector with a rated current of 5A with the TS24-U adapter or power supply (sold separately). Protect the electrical outlet with a weatherproof cover if it is located outdoors.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Check the Gate
chunks.question: Check the Gate
chunks.embedding_text: Before You Begin - Check the Gate
chunks.content_zh: 确保门扇垂直、水平，并且在铰链上自由摆动，没有卡滞或拖地。门扇应安装在用混凝土固定在地面的非常稳固的立柱或柱子上。安装前，修理或更换所有磨损或损坏的门五金件。
chunks.content_en: Ensure that the gate is plumb, level, and swings freely on its hinges without binding or dragging on the ground. The gate should be mounted to a very stable post or column that is secured in the ground with concrete. Repair or replace all worn or damaged gate hardware prior to installation.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Tools Needed
chunks.question: Tools Needed
chunks.embedding_text: Before You Begin - Tools Needed: Power Drill, Wire Strippers, Level, Phillips Screwdriver, Tape Measure, C-Clamps, Hacksaw, Bolt Cutters, Open End Wrenches.
chunks.content_zh: 所需工具：电钻、剥线钳、水平仪、十字螺丝刀、卷尺、C型夹（小型、中型和大型）、钢锯或重型断线钳、开口扳手（14#和17#或活动扳手）。
chunks.content_en: Tools Needed: Power Drill, Wire Strippers, Level, Phillips Screwdriver, Tape Measure, C-Clamps - small, medium, and large, Hacksaw or Heavy Duty Bolt Cutters, Open End Wrenches - 14# &17# or Adjustable Wrenches.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Items Not Included but May Needed
chunks.question: Items Not Included but May Needed
chunks.embedding_text: Before You Begin - Items Not Included but May Needed: Battery, Solar Panel, PVC Conduit, Connection Cable, Weatherproof Cover, Surge Protector.
chunks.content_zh:
不包含但可能需要的物品：
电池和太阳能电池板：如果您选择使用电池和太阳能电池板作为主要电源，您将需要24V 12Ah电池（不包含在内）。支持船用/汽车型电池或铅酸/GEL/AGM/富液（深循环电池）电池，锂离子电池除外。电池应防水，或放置在防水外壳中。A3S/A5S/A8S型号包含两块10W太阳能电池板和一个太阳能充电控制器。如果需要额外的太阳能电池板，TOPENS太阳能电池板套件可单独购买。
PVC导管：用于保护连接TC102红外光电传感器到控制板的电缆。
连接线：电源连接和有线附件安装可能需要连接线。请参阅本手册中的“电源连接”和“附件连接”部分以购买正确的电缆。
防风雨罩：如果电源插座位于室外，请使用防风雨罩进行保护。
浪涌保护器：建议将额定电流为5A的浪涌保护器与TS24-U适配器或电源（单独出售）一起使用。
chunks.content_en:
Items Not Included but May Needed:
Battery and Solar Panel: If you choose to use batteries and solar panels as main power source, you'll require 24V 12Ah battery (NOT included). Marine / automotive type battery or lead acid / GEL / AGM / flooded (deep cycle battery) batteries are supported, EXCEPT for lithium-ion battery. The batteries should be waterproof, or they should be placed in waterproof housing. Two 10W solar panels and one solar charge controller are included in A3S/A5S/A8S. If additional solar panel is needed, TOPENS solar panel kit is available for separate purchase.
PVC Conduit: Required to protect the cable connecting TC102 infrared photocell sensor to the control board.
Connection Cable: Connection cable may be required for power supply connection and wired accessories installation. Refer to the Connection of Power Supply and Connection of Accessories sections in this manual to purchase the correct cable.
Weatherproof Cover: Use a weatherproof cover to protect the electrical outlet if it is located outdoors.
Surge Protector: A surge protector with a rated current of 5A is recommended to use with the TS24-U adapter or power supply (sold separately).

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Install Electric Gate Lock
chunks.question: Install Electric Gate Lock
chunks.embedding_text: Before You Begin - Install Electric Gate Lock
chunks.content_zh: 在多风地区，使用电门锁至关重要，以确保门保持牢固关闭，并防止强风造成的损坏或故障。
chunks.content_en: In windy areas, it is crucial to use an electric gate lock to ensure the gate remains securely closed and to prevent damage or malfunction caused by strong winds.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · Install Photocell Sensor
chunks.question: Install Photocell Sensor
chunks.embedding_text: Before You Begin - Install Photocell Sensor
chunks.content_zh: 强烈建议在以下情况出于安全考虑安装光电传感器：如果您的物业有儿童或宠物，开门机自动关门功能设置为开启，开门机失速力设置为最大，安装了车辆出口传感器，或使用了其他门控制设备。
chunks.content_en: It is highly recommended to install a photocell sensor in the following situations for safety: if you have children or pets at your property, the gate opener auto close function is set to ON, the gate opener stall force is set to the maximum, a vehicle exit sensor is installed, or other gate control devices are used.

chunks.section: Before You Begin · 1 Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability
chunks.question: Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability
chunks.embedding_text: Before You Begin - Additional Hardware to Enhance Post Bracket Stability - Wooden post, Concrete post, Metal plate, Washer, Expansion bolts, Bracket stability
chunks.content_zh:
确保用于将支架固定到木桩的螺栓足够长，能够穿过整个木桩。
在螺栓和木桩之间添加金属板或更大的垫圈，以提高支架的稳定性。
对于混凝土桩，请使用膨胀螺栓牢固地安装支架。
如果桩的宽度或直径小于15厘米（6英寸），则应使用金属桩或将其固定在水泥中。
chunks.content_en:
Ensure that the bolts to attach post bracket to wooden post are long enough to pass through the entire post.
Add metal plate or larger washer between the bolt and the wooden post to improve bracket stability.
For concrete post, use expansion bolts to securely mount the bracket.
If the post's width or diameter is under 15cm (6"), it should be either metal or set in cement.

chunks.embedding_text: Pull-to-Open Gate Opener Mounting STEP 2 Determine Position Post Bracket Assembly opening angle table A B dimensions 开门角度 16cm 14cm 110
chunks.content_zh: 下表列出了根据尺寸A和B确定的大门最大开启角度。例如，若A为16cm(6.3")、B为14cm(5.5")，则大门最大开启角度为110°。测量A和B的尺寸以确定所需的开门角度，然后标记立柱支架的安装位置中心。拉式开门(Pull-to-Open)安装时，大门处于开启位置，且机械臂活动杆应完全缩回。
chunks.content_en: The table shows the maximum opening angle of the gate based on the dimensions of A and B. For example, if A is 16cm (6.3") and B is 14cm (5.5"), the maximum opening angle of the gate is 110°. Measure the dimension of A and B to determine the desired gate opening angle, then mark the center of the mounting locations for the post bracket accordingly.
